core_obligations: Set up the criterion (proof lines 2220-2228): for a sheaf of sets K on the target topos the author tests the extended Cech complex of f_*I, so that the goal is the vanishing of the higher cohomology of f_*I on the objects of the target topos.

Transfer the vanishing (proof lines 2231-2247): the author uses the adjunction and the injectivity of I to see that H^q(V, f_*I) vanishes for q greater than zero and every object V, which by the criterion gives total acyclicity.
proof_roadmap: Test total acyclicity of f_*I against the extended Cech complex of a surjection of sheaves of sets.
Use the adjunction to rewrite the relevant cohomology in terms of the source topos.
Use injectivity of I to kill the higher cohomology, and conclude with the criterion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the pushforward of an injective module along a morphism of ringed topoi is totally acyclic (statement lines 2211-2218). The proof applies the criterion of the companion lemma: it tests the extended Cech complexes of f_*I against surjections of sheaves of sets on the target (proof lines 2220-2228), and then uses the pullback-pushforward adjunction together with injectivity of I to show that the higher cohomology of f_*I vanishes on every object, which by the criterion is total acyclicity (proof lines 2231-2247). The non-formal content is the transfer of the vanishing across the adjunction. The claim is H2: one criterion and one adjunction computation.
